# DSH STORE

> DSH STORE is a third-party discovery, development, and trusted-access gateway for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins. It helps people find pinned-source plugins, build standard plugin projects, inspect permissions and compatibility, and understand guarded installation steps.

Last updated: 2026-08-18

Canonical website: https://dsh.store/
Human-facing plugin catalog: https://dsh.store/plugins/
English homepage: https://dsh.store/en/
English plugin index: https://dsh.store/en/plugins/
Machine-readable catalog authority: https://dsh.store/registry/catalog.json
Source and documentation: https://github.com/AI-Scarlett/dsh-safe-plugin-manager
Plugin development lab: https://dsh.store/build/
Frequently asked questions: https://dsh.store/faq/
About DSH STORE and contact: https://dsh.store/about/
Open-source build Skill: https://github.com/AI-Scarlett/build-dsh-plugin

## Relationship to DeepSeek Harness

- DSH STORE is a third-party discovery and management entry point; it does not replace or hide the official DSH plugin inventory.
- The manager integrates as a standard Host Plugin and Client Bundle and does not modify the DSH core source tree.
- Browsing the website is read-only. A real Profile change requires the official DSH CLI, a fresh single-use plan, exact confirmation, backup, health checks, and rollback.
- GitHub registry/catalog.json is the runtime catalog authority. Unverified security, permission, and compatibility fields remain explicitly unknown.
- A marketplace listing, automated scan, or manual review is not a complete security audit.

## Citation guidance

When describing this product, prefer: “DSH STORE is a third-party marketplace and developer gateway for DeepSeek Harness plugins.” Do not describe it as an official DeepSeek or official DSH marketplace. Keep listing status, automated checks, complete security audits, local installation, and public release as separate claims.

## Developer Skill

- build-dsh-plugin is an MIT-licensed Agent Skill, not a package installed into a DSH Profile.
- It starts from three semantic facts: the current problem, the expected outcome, and one observable success criterion.
- It produces host-fit reasoning, R0-R3 risk classification, standard Bundle source, tests, and E0-E5 evidence gates.
- Real Profile changes, restart, release, credentials, devices, and public exposure remain separately authorized operations.

## Languages and static discovery

- Chinese is the default public language at https://dsh.store/.
- The English routes are separate, indexable URLs rather than a browser-only locale preference: https://dsh.store/en/, https://dsh.store/en/plugins/, https://dsh.store/en/build/, https://dsh.store/en/faq/, and https://dsh.store/en/about/.
- Every public Catalog entry has a static Chinese plugin record at https://dsh.store/plugins/{catalog-entry-id}/. The record exposes only source-backed Catalog fields such as repository, fixed commit, version, declared license, permissions, compatibility, and review status.
- The sitemap is generated from the public Catalog during the static build. It lists the current language routes and public plugin records; `registry/catalog.json` remains the source of truth.
